text_block_list.text:
On Valentine's Day, Special Week called me out,
asking me to come to the Trainer's office.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah!
You came, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Since today is Valentine's Day,
I made some chocolates for you!

Looking over at the desk as prompted,
there rests something colossal, radiating an intimidating aura.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
My mama used to tell me,
"Cooking is love! And love means huge portions!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I put all of my gratitude towards you
into making this, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I was thinking of making enough to stuff you full,
but someone stopped me.
Astonishingly, it seems Special Week can easily finish this entire mountain of chocolate.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, if it's not enough,
I'll make as much as you want!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"It's my way of returning the favor for everything you do for me.
Please don't hesitate to ask!"
choice_data_list: Oh, thank you... Down the hatch.

text_block_list.text: I pushed through and finished all the chocolates I got from Special Week...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I'm so relieved to hear
it was to your liking, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like, how about seconds?
There are still plenty of ingredients left!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! Trainer-san!?
Are you okay!?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Please open your eyes!
Traiiiineeeer!!
And so, Valentine's Day with Special Week came to an end.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, Trainer.
Could you try taking a bite?"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"I taste-tested it, but if it's not to your liking,
I'll remake it right away...!"
choice_data_list: No, it's delicious, I tell you!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Really!?
Thank goodness~~!!
Right after Special Week said that, her stomach let out a loud rumble.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I-I'm sorry! Seeing you eat made me so hungry, Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure!?
Yaaay~♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Eating together makes it twice as delicious, doesn't it!
choice_data_list: Did your mother say that too?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
No! It was just a random thought of mine...
But it really is true, you know♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe♪
Happy Valentine's Day, Trainer!

I spent a heartwarming Valentine's Day
together with Special Week.
